method: Independent real-catalog dependency oracle plus complete production service-worker execution. Race cases substitute explicitly labelled small descriptor metadata only; native Request/Response/streams/AbortSignal/SHA-256 and production handlers, recovery verification and shared art writer remain active. No user stores, browser, audible-playback or physical Android claim.

results.name: Canonical package closure independently follows actual scene/wheel/CSS dependencies and source bytes
Status is read-only, reports actual missing bytes, and never counts protected rows for public scope
Missing-only resume keeps verified images and repairs same-length corrupt bytes using direct canonical network fetches
Source bytes of correct length and MIME but wrong hash cannot be saved or reported ready
Cache eviction after a ready receipt is detected by the next status without fetching or mutating
Wrong content type, failed HTTP, redirect, oversized and short network bodies remain missing
Unreadable optional-cache responses are unknown and never manufacture a retry plan or ready state
Source ownership, app route, package id, plan scope and per-client token reject before image work
A newer plan invalidates earlier plans and a completed plan cannot replay across a changed cache
Quota reserve denial preserves existing cache bytes and reports a truthful partial receipt
Cancellation during streamed source fetch aborts it, fences the job and prevents late image writes
Client navigation retires a live download before bytes can commit
Pinned and unreadable recovery selections reject package preparation without image work
Rollback selected while network bodies are pending prevents package admissions
Cancellation during quota admission prevents the queued cache write
Cancellation during unabortable Cache.put rolls back before acknowledgement and permits a fresh request
Missing mandatory navigation blocks image download and never copies core art into optional storage
All package images verified cannot claim readiness when an independent core Tekke prerequisite is missing
Cancel acknowledgement drains both slots when one source rejects while the other Cache.put is unabortable
Successful source completion releases the reader without cancelling it or aborting its completed fetch
A restarted worker derives readiness from shared cache bytes rather than an in-memory completion counter
Malformed or aliased catalog members are rejected by the actual parser despite a matching catalog digest
Cache write failure preserves prior verified art and never reports successful storage
Failed rollback is reported as a cancellation failure rather than an acknowledged clean stop
A queued package ticket cancels before an unrelated legacy writer finishes and performs no late cache work
Cancelling an explicit budget scan stops reading unrelated stalled art without waiting for its source to close
Uncontrolled app-route clients cannot inspect or download packages but can cancel an earlier owned job
Navigation during the post-put recovery-state await rolls back before returning any result
Cancelling one first-use manifest reader does not cancel another client independently checking the catalog
